title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - November 11, 2025

### Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - November 11, 2025

#### Story

A curated subset of lore videos is now watchable directly in the game. Be sure to check back when new lore beats are added!

#### Spirit Showdown

From November 11-24, spirits decide your fate in the Arcade! Swap heroes when eliminating enemies or after dying two times.

As you complete challenges, you'll earn exclusive free Spirit-themed rewards!

#### Junkrat's Loot Hunt

Junkrat's Loot Hunt is back again, running from November 20-23! Earn lootboxes by completing challenges that unlock as you play!

#### General Updates

Player Progression

* Retired badges and sub-badges are accessible in the game again. Career Profile → Progression → Legacy.
* Overwatch 1 player level has also been moved to the Legacy screen.

Player Cards

* In Role Queue modes, instead of showing highest leveled heroes across the hero roster, player cards now show your highest leveled heroes in the role you are playing.
* Non-Role Queue modes will continue to show highest leveled heroes across the entire roster.

Advanced Info Panel

* Added the "Jump Cancel" keyword to abilities that can be ended early for bonus movement.

#### Tank

![D.Va ](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/HRA1/256X256/e69a3d819fd46d0dcd1d9474c248a95e69519c20077c60e9de73a1e2d3acdbb6-t.png)

##### D.Va

Extended Booster Perk

* Boosters now deal 100% additional damage.

![Hazard](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ajub/256X256/22fc6ca76249d7cd37bad808d53a68986da855c625475a46ec3858abecf57823-t.png)

##### Hazard

With Hazard’s block now less reliable against burst damage, this change increases his mobility, allowing him to reposition and engage more effectively.

Spike Guard

* No longer prevents critical damage.

Violent Leap

* Cooldown reduced from 6 to 5.5 seconds.

Spike Guard

No longer prevents critical damage.

Violent Leap

Cooldown reduced from 6 to 5.5 seconds.

![Orisa](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/42MR/256X256/20c12a10cfe0b5608f9eec63a74ecb0ccd18a114019bc77bb2765f87776e17ed-t.png)

##### Orisa

Alongside Hazard’s updates, these adjustments address specific interactions that were previously mitigated by these defensive abilities, such as Mauga’s Ignited critical damage and Reinhardt’s Earthshatter.

Fortify and Terra Surge now only prevent headshot critical damage and not forced crits

![Ramattra ](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/j2od/256X256/cf69d4bfa61ac14f61d3d541b0d2687a20fa24f55afe7a392d746f5ccb138dea-t.png)

##### Ramattra

Previous changes led to a healthier overall playstyle for Ramattra, but he could feel too fragile in certain matchups. Increasing his base health improves survivability in both forms.

-Base health increased from 250 to 275

Relentless Form Perk

* No longer has half effectiveness while in Annihilation

![Wrecking Ball](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/YoLt/256X256/f71d6948e8b6ae340e20ab569ef66d24aead6032c34a7ec09a00ea864b413a24-t.png)

##### Wrecking Ball

Wrecking Ball can be extremely difficult to punish due to his high health pool and mobility, especially without strong crowd control. Reducing his base armor lowers overall survivability while rewarding effective Adaptive Shield usage.

Base armor reduced from 175 to 125

![Zarya](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Pqra/256X256/d43075cba10cd711a129556142849587e78f1f55b0105d39a640da53ffa64e1b-t.png)

##### Zarya

* Energy Converter Perk
* Energy gained reduced from 3 to 2

#### Damage

![Ashe](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/MHjO/256X256/e41d918d0e7ffa772b5571df3d0dc1a05e6d9032307f78be935972cfd59f208a-t.png)

##### Ashe

Increasing Ashe’s falloff range allows her to perform more consistently at her intended mid- to long-range distances.

The Viper

* Secondary Fire falloff range rescaled from 30–50 meters to 40–60 meters

![Cassidy](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/cDlt/256X256/8d161c49df5a962ece9ceafc6500bea473d9dd3695b9e24e39d5be616295e6c5-t.png)

##### Cassidy

Flashbang’s short hinder duration could feel difficult to capitalize on. This slight increase gives Cassidy players a more reliable window to follow up when landing a Flashbang.

Flashbang

* Hinder duration increased from 0.9 to 1.2 seconds

![Echo](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/SuXL/256X256/0dc3f1679d739ef530ba2b8cbe02bf09f4d40a57c0af84f694a3241d3a7ef948-t.png)

##### Echo

Echo can struggle to safely position within her effective range. Increasing her aerial acceleration during Flight gives her more control when engaging or escaping.

Flight

* Movement acceleration in air increased by 100% when changing directions while Flight is active.

![Genji](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/0Z23/256X256/190a3dd9a5a4c8daeff9ec4da861f43cb28116964e89dc7416da104d8fae9134-t.png)

##### Genji

Shuriken

Base projectile size reduced from 0.1 to 0.05

![Mei](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/vltO/256X256/08586dceed41e030d575b2b643118f55390f1c2af91dd15394528f5399fcc934-t.png)

##### Mei

This damage increase ensures Mei’s Primary Fire remains the consistent choice in close-range duels.

Primary Fire

* Damage per second increased from 100 to 110

![Sojourn](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/s1fh/256X256/515f25a729a4a3f51d956fc54c600dc60d8e5242f2b188c178496cea1a2e11b5-t.png)

##### Sojourn

These adjustments make Disruptor Shot easier to land and more reliable without increasing its travel distance.

Disruptor Shot

* Damage per second increased from 80 to 90
* Projectile speed increased from 30 to 40
* Maximum travel duration reduced from 1 to 0.75 seconds

![Sombra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ZL8X/256X256/f348c1704dc50c009ac8acf6912a5a77eaf2a3acdd34e56927190af9eb9145d1-t.png)

##### Sombra

Healthy Hacker has struggled to provide consistent value as a result of its short active window. These adjustments extend its effectiveness and offer more opportunities to benefit from the perk, even when combat occurs away from health packs.

Hidden Upload Perk

* Stealth duration on successful hack increased from 2 to 3 seconds

Healthy Hacker Perk

* Time before overhealth degeneration increased from 6 to 10 seconds
* Overhealth degeneration increased from 10 to 25
* Overhealth granted increased from 50 to 75
* Packs can now be picked up at full overhealth to reset the degeneration timer

![Tracer](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/kav7/256X256/5ee20a1feed14da5153f19745328e9fc02bd79f8109593a9b7dab9283eb9629b-t.png)

##### Tracer

Pulse Pistols

No longer gain the increased global projectile size (0.04 meters)

#### Support

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261016/lenc/256X256/51b93ea59f369a1defa78e5d08c12b1391f5d2d94614a51fd95c125a7a6151fa-t.png)

##### Brigitte

Brigitte’s healing output can sometimes feel limited compared to other supports. Reducing Repair Pack’s cooldown provides more consistent healing across all situations.

Repair Pack

* Cooldown reduced from 5.5 to 5 seconds

![Juno](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/PZaG/256X256/2a65bf12035f9c255833693224cad83fd98cead625fdf1b9da8359a7f259e01c-t.png)

##### Juno

This partial reversion to Juno’s previous air strafing makes her movement more responsive without making her overly evasive to fight against.

Glide Boost

* Movement acceleration in air increased by 50% when changing directions while Glide Boost active.

![Kiriko](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/3S0F/256X256/24d1d7bf86c331b3d81b934442ed36fd0121f6815255c6f26f456127fb342d15-t.png)

##### Kiriko

Kiriko’s Ultimate remains one of the most powerful in the game because of its large area and the value it provides to her team. Increasing its cost brings its time to earn more in line with its impact.

Ultimate cost increased by 8%

![Lifeweaver](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Krhv/256X256/57d5014ab6034db9138f838e8450693b4a97ab3c54f85d594b199a8853e75ccb-t.png)

##### Lifeweaver

Lifeweaver’s larger model made him much easier to hit than most supports. With his lower health pool, this hitbox reduction offsets that loss in survivability, while weapon swap improvements make his gameplay smoother and more responsive.

* Model and hit volume size reduced by 8%

Healing Blossom/Thorn Volley

* Automatic reload time for the inactive weapon reduced from 2.5 seconds to 2 seconds
* Time between weapon swap reduced from 0.25 seconds to 0.125 seconds

#### 6v6 Hero Changes

Most changes made to 5v5 are reflected in 6v6 unless otherwise noted. This patch aims to maintain consistent balance between the two modes while addressing outliers, particularly among tanks. Heroes that currently feel strongest or weakest in 6v6 have been adjusted to ensure a more balanced experience.

![D.Va](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/HRA1/256X256/e69a3d819fd46d0dcd1d9474c248a95e69519c20077c60e9de73a1e2d3acdbb6-t.png)

##### D.Va

Health reduced from 350 to 300.

Defense Matrix

* Recharge rate reduced by 15%.

![Doomfist](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/RMnB/256X256/bc538b345188bdcb2d2be5b2894d471ba54aeea53b03862429205ed49d693bbe-t.png)

##### Doomfist

The Best Defense

* Overhealth gained per target reduced from 35 to 25 HP.

Power Block

* Amount of damage to gain Empowered Punch increased from 100 to 120.

![Junkerqueen](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/l56P/256X256/cf66adfac58a0321ec1f7d3a7241d6bf2f3b311707064d2f0ace2e3f4e342727-t.png)

##### Junkerqueen

Base health increased from 425 to 450.

Adrenaline Rush

* Self-healing from wounds damage scalar increased from 1.5x to 1.75x.

![Mauga](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Q4VP/256X256/6dbd80a0b40bd0464db35948f98d91ecc6dfcede8c94ff9b1ecefda781a7aa1f-t.png)

##### Mauga

Cardiac Overdrive

* Cooldown reduced from 17 to 15 seconds.

![Reinhardt](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/NXlt/256X256/b5e3a4f5629a3acfd47b5d2e695e79ea964b060bf67b7e4f8f15e63accd5f934-t.png)

##### Reinhardt

Barrier Field

* Shield health increased from 1500 to 1800.

![Winston](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/2iGO/256X256/6a9a37012551410b46b2c28146404354fe21e4a1e8ea65db4e1e497eeaa05c71-t.png)

##### Winston

Jump Pack

* Cooldown reduced from 6 to 5 seconds.

![Wrecking Ball](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/YoLt/256X256/f71d6948e8b6ae340e20ab569ef66d24aead6032c34a7ec09a00ea864b413a24-t.png)

##### Wrecking Ball

Base health reduced from 500 to 475.

Adaptive Shields

* Overhealth gained per target reduced from 75 to 50.

![Zenyatta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/NBQo/256X256/9367143a32f3fc07781330a0b26c6f1087361204a2b7e4088d1daf26428273f2-t.png)

##### Zenyatta

Orb of discord

* Now has a cooldown per target.

#### Stadium Updates

General Stadium Changes

* Drafts have been updated to use blind pick system. This means that both players on each time pick at the same time and their hero is revealed together.
* Draft mode now automatically assigns tanks to the 5th slot.
* Players are now able to unequip powers on the same round they are equipped.
* Powers are locked at the end of the Armory timer.
* HP bars are now displayed for your team in Stadium matches.
* The hero stat section in the Armory has been updated to sort by your highest stat increases.
* Detailed tooltips for each row in the Armory hero stat section have been added.
* Impacted abilities and weapons are displayed in these tooltips.
* Interact on any tooltip to access the full details screen.

Stadium Combat Text Changes

* Weapon Power and Ability Power are now displayed as two separate floating numbers. This feature can be adjusted from Settings.
* A new setting has been added to adjust the lifetime of floating text.
* A new setting has been added to display self-healing. This setting is defaulted to off.
* We are now dynamically adjusting the height at which floating text is displayed to improve visibility for heroes in melee range.
* Overkill and overhealing values are now displayed when eliminating an enemy or healing a friendly target.
* Kill cameras will now display stadium combat text.
* Improved the stability of stadium combat text on moving targets so it’s less distracting.

#### Stadium - Tank

![Hazard](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ajub/256X256/22fc6ca76249d7cd37bad808d53a68986da855c625475a46ec3858abecf57823-t.png)

##### Hazard

Hazard’s wall-focused powers were hitting a little too hard, dishing out big burst damage on top of strong zoning potential. We’ve reduced the knockback damage for both Off The Wall and Fortress to make the ability feel fairer to play against while keeping its area control and impact intact.

Off The Wall - Power

* Damage decreased to 60 (Down from 80).

Fortress - Power

* Damage decreased to 25 (Down from 40).

![Orisa](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/42MR/256X256/20c12a10cfe0b5608f9eec63a74ecb0ccd18a114019bc77bb2765f87776e17ed-t.png)

##### Orisa

A few hero items were lagging behind in overall value and flexibility, so we’re giving them some extra polish. Enhanced Target Sensors and Oladele-copter Blades now offer more meaningful offensive boosts, Efi’s Theorem gains defensive utility to help sustain in fights, and HollaGram Helmet gets a price cut to make it easier for Orisa to support the team if they need unstoppable.

Enhanced Target Sensors - Rare Weapon Hero Item

* Added: +10% Attack Speed
* Added: +5% Weapon Power

Oladele-copter Blades- Epic Ability Hero Item

* Added: +15% Ability Power
* Added: +15% Weapon Power

Efi's Theorem - Epic Ability Hero Item

* Added: +25 Armor

HollaGram Helmet - Epic Survival Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 9000 (Down from 10000)

#### Stadium - Damage

![Freja](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Otll/256X256/828848437c49bc5ed4a2cf900c85986a4af265d71d1ea9ddf260b8a0236f71a9-t.png)

##### Freja

These changes are aimed at adding more build variety for Freja and making her weaker options more viable choices. We're also reducing the vertical burst of her Weapon Power build, and adding an additional lever for us to have more fine tune control for further adjustments if needed.

Volley à Deux - Power

* Spread of additional bolts reduced by 60%.
* Additional bolts fire every 3rd shot (Down from every 5th shot).

Peak Performance - Power

* Added +20% Updraft Height.

Forager - Power

* Max Life per hit increased to 8% (Up from 5%).

Windwalker Boots - Rare Ability Hero Item

* Added: "Take Aim Bolt Explosion damage reduces Updraft Cooldown by 1s".
* Removed: +20% Updraft Height.
* Added: 5% Ability Power.
* Removed: 5% Cooldown Reduction.

Aeroweave Cloak - Rare Survival Hero Item

* Added: Restore 10% Max Ammo every 1s while momentum is slowed by Take Aim.

Cyclone - Power

* Added: 25% reduced explosion damage from extra Take Aim Bolt.

![Sojourn](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/s1fh/256X256/515f25a729a4a3f51d956fc54c600dc60d8e5242f2b188c178496cea1a2e11b5-t.png)

##### Sojourn

Sojourn’s Disruptor Shot build was too costly for the payoff it provided, making it hard to justify in most matches. We’ve reduced the build’s overall expense and improved her defensive options through Power Slide buffs, giving her more flexibility to reposition and stay in the fight longer.

Hard Stuck - Power

* Damage reduction decreased to 25% (Down from 50%).

Liao's Logistics Data - Epic Ability Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 10000 (Down from 11000)

Energy Leech - Rare Ability Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 4000 (Down from 5000)

Fine-Tuned Thrusters - Power

* Damage reduction increased to 35% (Up from 25%).

Zoom Zoom Zoom - Power

* Attack Speed increased to 35% (Up from 25%).
* Weapon Lifesteal increased to 100% (Up from 50%).

Experimental Tech - Power

* Slow increased to 25% (Up from 15%).
* Railgun Charge increased to 50% (Up from 33%).

![Junkrat](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/28m3/256X256/d3628dc64d78ca6dc2a8b509cf5a6fc417c0f5068d5f75d1f5c094be1f58ee4e-t.png)

##### Junkrat

Junkrat's Ability Power builds have struggled to find their footing compared to his Weapon Power builds, so we're adding more power and consistency to both his Concussion Mine and Trap centric builds for increased build variety.

Hop Boom - Power

* Concussion Mine damage upon landing after detonating Concussion Mine on yourself increased to 20% reduced effectiveness (Up from 30% reduced effectiveness).

Trap II Esquire - Power

* Removed Arming time to spawn Mini Steel Trap.
* Max Number of Mini Steel Traps increased to 5 (Up from 2).

Rainin' Lead - Power

* Frequency increased to every 0.25s (Up from 0.3s).

Jamison's Jumpers - Epic Ability Hero Item

* Added: "Detonating Concussion Mine on yourself reduces Concussion Mine cooldown by 15%".
* Removed: +20% Concussion Mine Knockback Distance.
* Added 25 Health.

Refreshing Radiation - Epic Survival Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 9000 (Down from 10000).
* Max Life Overhealth increased to 8% (Up from 5%).
* Overhealth Duration increased to 5s (Up from 3s).

Lithium Alloy - Epic Ability Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 9500 (Down from 10000).
* Added: +10% Ability Power.

Rat Pack - Rare Ability Hero Item

* Ability Power increased to 10% (Up from 5%).
* Steel Trap Health increased to 100% (Up from 50%).

Charged Chompas - Epic Ability Hero Item

* Ultimate Charge gain now triggers on all Ability damage (Instead of just Total Mayhem damage).

Spiked Gloves - Rare Weapon Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 4000 (Down from 4500).

Thermal Trap - Rare Survival Hero Item

* Cost decreased to 3750 (Down from 4000).

#### Stadium - Support

![Juno](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/PZaG/256X256/2a65bf12035f9c255833693224cad83fd98cead625fdf1b9da8359a7f259e01c-t.png)

##### Juno

Bringing back the extra heal that Medicinal Missiles used to have. This boost adds more sustain for allies and makes her supportive playstyle feel even more rewarding when landing those precise shots.

Medicinal Missiles - Power

* Now heals extra 30 health on pulsar hit.

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261016/lenc/256X256/51b93ea59f369a1defa78e5d08c12b1391f5d2d94614a51fd95c125a7a6151fa-t.png)

##### Brigitte

Brigitte's Weapon Power build has remained niche and difficult to justify over her other build options. We're adding a bit more firepower and survivability here to make it a more viable option in the right situation.

Whirlwhip - Power

* Bonus Damage on 360 Rocket Flail swing increased to 125% (Up from 100%).

Righteous Cleave - Power

* Healing on next Rocket Flail swing increased to 125% of damage dealt (Up from 100%).

#### Bug Fixes

General Fixes

* Fixed an issue with Wuyang and Illari that caused incorrect Healing and Resource rates to be applied when affected by Attack Speed increases.
* Fixed an issue where the Headhunter perk ignored headshot damage reduction from Bob's Tank passive.
* Fixed an issue where Reinhardt's Charge did not pull Wrecking Ball out of Roll mode.
* Fixed an issue where Mei's Deep Freeze perk could potentially freeze enemies twice within a short timeframe.
* Fixed an issue where characters affected by Ana's Groggy were still slowed after using an ability that should have cleansed the Groggy effect.
* Fixed an issue where Sojourn's charge was lost after a primary fire when using the Overcharged perk.
* Fixed an issue where the timer for Mercy's resurrect was not shown in ping messages.
* Fixed several minor color and formatting issues in Advanced Info Panel text.

Stadium Fixes

* Fixed an issue where Kiriko's clone could inadvertently stop the payload from moving due to too many friendly players on the objective.
* Fixed an issue where the Salvaged Slug item interrupted Winston's primary fire to reload the granted ammo.
* Fixed an issue where Reaper's aim was not accurate immediately after using Shadow Step.
* Fixed an issue where the size of the mini Steel Trap from Junkrat's "Trap II, Esquire" power was not accurate relative to its trigger timing.
* Fixed an issue where Hazard's Downpour ability did not gain benefits from life steal bonuses.
* Fixed an issue where Torbjorn's Clocked Power gave the benefit to all allied heroes instead of just Torbjorn.

### 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年11月11日

#### 故事

精选的部分剧情视频现在可以直接在游戏中观看。当有新的剧情内容添加时，请务必回来查看！

#### 灵界对决

11月11日至24日，灵魂将在街机先锋中决定你的命运！消灭敌人或死亡两次后更换英雄。

完成挑战即可赢取专属的免费灵魂主题奖励！

#### 狂鼠的寻宝行动

狂鼠的寻宝行动再次回归，活动时间为11月20日至23日！通过游玩解锁并完成挑战，赢取战利品箱！

#### 综合更新

玩家进度

* 已退役的徽章和子徽章现在可以在游戏中再次查看。生涯概况 → 进度 → 传承。
* 《守望先锋》1代的玩家等级也已移至传承界面。

玩家名片

* 在预设职责模式中，玩家名片现在不再显示整个英雄阵容中等级最高的英雄，而是显示你当前所玩职责中等级最高的英雄。
* 非预设职责模式将继续显示整个阵容中等级最高的英雄。

进阶信息面板

* 为可以通过跳跃提前结束以获得额外移动能力的技能添加了“跳跃取消”关键词。

#### 重装

![D.Va ](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/HRA1/256X256/e69a3d819fd46d0dcd1d9474c248a95e69519c20077c60e9de73a1e2d3acdbb6-t.png)

##### D.Va

推进器延展特长

* 推进器现在造成100%的额外伤害。

![Hazard](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ajub/256X256/22fc6ca76249d7cd37bad808d53a68986da855c625475a46ec3858abecf57823-t.png)

##### 骇灾

由于骇灾的格挡现在对抗爆发伤害的可靠性降低，此项改动增加了他的机动性，使他能够更有效地重新调整位置和交战。

尖刺防御

* 不再免疫暴击伤害。

猛烈跳跃

* 冷却时间从6秒缩短至5.5秒。

尖刺防御

不再免疫暴击伤害。

猛烈跳跃

冷却时间从6秒缩短至5.5秒。

![Orisa](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/42MR/256X256/20c12a10cfe0b5608f9eec63a74ecb0ccd18a114019bc77bb2765f87776e17ed-t.png)

##### 奥丽莎

与骇灾的更新类似，这些调整解决了以前由这些防御技能缓解的特定互动问题，例如毛加的“点燃”暴击伤害和莱因哈特的“裂地猛击”。

强固防御和惊天撼地现在仅免疫爆头暴击伤害，不再免疫强制暴击。

* 武器强度和技能强度现在显示为两个独立的浮动数字。此功能可在设置中调整。

* 添加了一项新设置以显示自我治疗。此设置默认为关闭。
* 我们现在会动态调整浮动文本的显示高度，以提高近战范围内英雄的可见性。
* 消灭敌人或治疗友方目标时，现在会显示溢出伤害和溢出治疗数值。
* 击杀回放现在将显示角斗领域战斗文本。

##### 布丽吉塔

布丽吉塔的武器强度构建相对于其他构建选项来说仍然比较小众且难以证明其价值。我们在此增加了一些火力及生存能力，使其在合适的情况下成为更可行的选择。

旋风鞭 - 能力

* 360度流星飞锤挥击的额外伤害增加至125%（原为100%）。

正义劈砍 - 能力

* 下一次流星飞锤挥击的治疗量增加至造成伤害的125%（原为100%）。

#### 错误修复

通用修复

* 修复了无漾和伊拉锐在受到攻击速度增加影响时，治疗和资源速率应用不正确的问题。
* 修复了“猎头者”特长无视鲍勃的重装被动爆头伤害减免的问题。
* 修复了莱因哈特的冲锋无法将破坏球撞出滚轮模式的问题。
* 修复了美的“深度冻结”特长可能在短时间内对敌人进行两次冻结的问题。
* 修复了受安娜“昏沉”影响的角色在使用本应清除昏沉效果的技能后仍然被减速的问题。
* 修复了索杰恩在使用“过载”特长时，普通攻击后充能丢失的问题。
* 修复了天使复活的计时器未在信号信息中显示的问题。
* 修复了进阶信息面板文本中的几个次要颜色和格式问题。

角斗领域修复

* 修复了雾子的分身可能因为目标点上友方玩家过多而意外阻止运载目标移动的问题。
* 修复了“回收的弹头”物品打断温斯顿普通攻击以装填所获弹药的问题。
* 修复了死神在使用暗影步后瞄准不准确的问题。
* 修复了狂鼠“捕兽夹二世”能力产生的迷你捕兽夹大小与其触发时机不准确的问题。
* 修复了骇灾的“倾盆大雨”技能无法从生命偷取加成中获益的问题。
* 修复了托比昂的“打卡”能力将增益效果提供给所有盟友英雄而不仅仅是托比昂的问题。
